verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the overview's claim that ByteAsk 'reads your codebase' as part of its agent loop. That implies the agent gathers context itself rather than needing files selected by hand, but nothing documents mapping or explaining a whole unfamiliar codebase. missing for 10: documented codebase mapping or architecture explanation, automatic context discovery or indexing across a large repo, independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase-understanding quality.
